title: DashboardTokenClaims
description: Claims AGB-904 adds to the access token. All optional and additive: a token issued before the change has none of them and is an adult token. Consumers use profileOf / isStudentToken from dashboard/index.js, never read `profile` directly.

ProfileTokenClaims.title: ProfileTokenClaims
ProfileTokenClaims.description: The additional claims only; the token carries its other claims (sub, scope, exp, ...) unchanged. For a student token `sub` is the student's own subject id, `guardian` the parent's subject id.

guardian.description: The parent's subject id. Present on student tokens.

consent_v.description: The consent version the profile was switched in under.
